Bug_Title: Double Brace Initialization should not be used
Bug_Explanation: Double Brace Initialization creates an anonymous inner class with a reference to the instance of the owning object. This can lead to memory leaks if the anonymous class is held by other objects. It also makes the code harder to maintain and understand.
